title: Trump advocates for mail and early voting despite historically opposing both | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

President Donald Trump said Americans should cast their ballot using “every appropriate tool,” in a pre-recorded video imploring Republicans to vote in the midterm elections, including using methods that he hashistorically opposed like early and mail voting.

“If your state has early voting, do not wait. Go out and vote,” Trump said in the video posted Saturday morning to his Truth Social account. “Vote early, vote by mail, or vote in person on Election Day.”

Trump’s message is notable because he has criticized mail-in voting for years and pushed to limit it since the start of his second term, though many of those efforts have been blocked by courts.

It comes as Trump’s midterm strategy has relied heavily onturning out his base, and less so on persuading undecided voters to support GOP candidates.

“It’s all a turnout game,” a GOP campaign official told CNN last month. “From day one, the campaign committees and the president’s political operation have been sharing data to make sure we’re hammering the exact people we need to turn out.”

The Supreme Courtrejected sweeping restrictionslast month that would have changed how mail ballots are sent to voters in advance of the midterm elections. The decision came afterstate election officialswarned that they did not have enough time to enact the provisions that stemmed from a March executive order the president issued.

Trump issued a lengthy reaction on social media responding to the decision, labeling the country’s mail-in voting system a “‘disaster,’ which is a laughing stock all over the World, and where we are the only country that has to endure such a Nation Destroying SCAM.”

The president has also aggressively pushed Congress to enact restrictions on mail-in voting through the “SAVE America Act,” afederal elections overhaul billthat has met bipartisan opposition in the Senate.

Despite falsely claiming that mail-in voting has resulted in extensive fraud, Trump hascontinued to vote by mail himself, including in a Florida state House special election in March.

It’s not the first time the president has contradicted his own comments about voting methods in the lead up to an election. In 2024, Trump’s campaignlaunched“Swamp The Vote USA” to promote absentee, mail-in and early voting. He referred to the program in his video message Saturday.

CNN has reached out to the White House for comment on the video and whether it marks a shift in the president’s views on early and mail voting.

With one month before the midterms, overone million ballotshave already been cast. In several states with key Senate or governor races this fall,Democratsmake up a larger share of voters requesting ballots so far than they did at this point in 2024.

In recent years, Democrats have been much more likely to vote prior to Election Day.

CNN’s Kristen Holmes and Alayna Treene contributed to this report.
